question: In January 2025, how many sportspeople were awarded with the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award for the year 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In January 2025, **4 sportspeople** were awarded the prestigious Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award for the year 2024.
 
• The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is the **highest sporting honour** in India.
 
• This award is given annually to recognize outstanding achievements in sports and games at the international level.
 
• The recipients are selected by a committee constituted by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• Recipients are honoured with a medal, certificate, and cash prize to acknowledge their contributions and accomplishments in sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The award was instituted in **1991-1992** and was previously known as the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
 
• In **August 2021**, the award was renamed after Major Dhyan Chand, India’s legendary hockey player.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand is widely regarded as one of the greatest field hockey players of all time, often referred to as the "Hockey Wizard."
 
• Eligibility for the award includes remarkable performance in sports at the international level over four years preceding the award year.
 
• Notable past recipients of the award include Sachin Tendulkar (Cricket), PV Sindhu (Badminton), and Mary Kom (Boxing).
 
• The award highlights the government’s commitment to promoting sports and recognizing the achievements of Indian sportspeople on the global stage.
